item.tib: zhi ba mkha' 'gying dkar po'i sgrub pa sku gsum don sgrub yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: de ltar sku gsum sgrub pa mong don sgron ni/ sprul sku ye shes gtsug phud bka' lung ste/ gsang 'dus stag la la sogs rim gyis rgyud (brgyud) do/ stong rgyung gi (gis) gter du sbas/ phyi rab (rabs) gshen po rnams kyi spyod par shog 'di rdol rim gyis brgyad nas da lta sgom chung bdag la 'o//
